title: Fan-in of the binarized circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose each gate has pairwise distinct arguments and every negation gate has exactly one argument. After binarization, every gate still has pairwise distinct arguments, every negation gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has pairwise distinct arguments
Each negation gate has exactly one argument
